purpose: Express a resemblance or inference based on indications.
keywords: Plain verb / い-adjective + ようだ; noun + のようだ; な-adjective + なようだ.
That cloud looks like a fish.
It seems they are having a meeting next door.
This problem does not seem easy.
Share information or express your own impression
formation: Plain verb / い-adjective + ようだ; noun + のようだ; な-adjective + なようだ.
restrictions: The evidence may be indirect or sensory; formation differs by word class.
mistake: Use noun + のようだ rather than noun + ようだ directly.
